thread:
maya_newhire: hey folks, day 1 hiccup. all our IPv4-only internal endpoints (registry 10.20.5.2, git 10.30.4.2) fail from my laptop, but i have native IPv6 on my home link. wireguard shows a handshake. anyone run into ipv6-only ISP oddities? :thinking:

ipv6-bot: WireGuard endpoint detected: peer=maya_newhire, endpoint=[2001:db8::1]:51820, latest_handshake=5s

ryan-sre: welcome! yes, some ISPs offer IPv6-only w/ NAT64/DNS64 & CGNAT for IPv4 which can break access to internal IPv4 services behind allowlists. can you try `ping -4 10.20.5.2` and `curl -4 http://10.20.5.2:5000/v2/` and paste output? also `traceroute -n 10.20.5.2`?

maya_newhire: `ping -4` times out. curl -4 fails with connection timed out. traceroute shows next hop 100.64.0.1 then nothing. IPv6 traceroute reaches our peering fine.

ryan-sre: that 100.64.0.1 is carrier NAT for IPv4. quick onboarding workaround: tunnel the registry over the bastion so traffic egresses from our network: `ssh -L 5000:10.20.5.2:5000 maya@bastion.redwood.internal -N` then `docker pull localhost:5000/redwood/base:latest`.

maya_newhire: tried the ssh -L trick and it worked, pulled the image. phew! :relieved:

ryan-sre: long-term options were evaluating: a TLS proxy/mirror for the registry or updating onboarding docs with IPv6 notes. another local workaround is temporarily disabling IPv6 on your laptop during onboarding (`sudo sysctl -w net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6=1`) so IPv4 path is used, but only do that if you're comfortable.

olivia-security: policy note: do not expand egress allowlists to include consumer/ISP ranges. SSH tunnel or registry proxy are acceptable onboarding mitigations. please include justification when filing the ticket (new-hire + IPv6-only ISPs).

maya_newhire: can someone add the registry-tunnel and ipv6 note to the new-hires checklist? saved my morning.

ticket-bot: created NET-1001: "onboarding: IPv6/CGNAT - registry proxy + doc updates" (created by ryan-sre).
